name: Medium Orchid
lede: Medium Orchid is a bright, blue-leaning violet-pink, one of the named colors of the web.

sections.title: A web color
sections.body:
Paterson lists MediumOrchid as one of the colours in the X11 Color Set, with the hex code #BA55D3 [1]. In his colour index it is filed among the violets, next to DarkOrchid, DarkViolet and MediumVioletRed [2]. The flower gave the family its name, but the value is a screen color, not a petal measurement.

It is one of a run of "Medium" names in the set, and in painting the word medium means something else: the liquid or binder that carries pigment [1][3]. The two senses share a spelling and nothing else.

The set also contains DarkOrchid, which sits in the same index run of violets, so a reader choosing between them is choosing a shade on a screen [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: This is a strongly chromatic purple, with a chroma of 76 [4]. Our records list its sources as the CSS color set and Wikipedia [4]. Its nearest standard name is [[amethyst]], 6.9 ΔE away [4]. Related names: [[orchid]], [[dark-orchid]], [[violet]] and [[medium-purple]].
